description: The opt-in gpp module (a consent provider) reading the US sections of the gpp string that gpp_sid names. An opt-out of sale, sharing or targeted advertising, or a known child without consent, denies storage and deletes the ID cookies, like GPC, with or without GDPR and over a TC string that allows storage; no opt-out changes nothing (it never grants); sections gpp_sid does not list, and non-US sections, are ignored; an unreadable string, when gpp_sid names a US section, denies. GPP strings: encoded with the IAB reference library (@iabgpp/cmpapi 3.2.0), except DBACNY~… and DBABM~…, the IAB Consent String Specification's own examples. DBABLA~CVQaAAAAAABA.QA is US National v2 with SaleOptOut=1 (DBABLA~CVQqAAAAAABA.QA: every opt-out 2); DBABBg~BUkAAABA.QA California SharingOptOut=1; DBABJg~BFkAAEA.QA Colorado TargetedAdvertisingOptOut=1, DBABJg~BFoAAUA.QA its KnownChildSensitiveDataConsents=1; DBABUYA~BQVA.AAA Indiana SaleOptOut=1; DBACMMA~… TCF EU v2 and US National SaleOptOut=1. TC string CAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA.eAAAAAAAAA has publisher consent for purposes 1-2.
